name: GHIST+-Adapt v3
frozen: 2026-11-09, before any v3 fit or metric on any slide
question: Given measured RNA from a few TMA-like tissue cores of a slide, does a lightweight post-hoc adapter on frozen GHIST+ predictions improve GHIST+ on the rest of that slide, across the paper's own metrics?

slides.breast5k: development (adapter ideas from v1/v2 were developed on this slide)
slides.atera: confirmation: no adapter has been fitted or evaluated on it before this protocol was frozen
slides.breast2: confirmation (BreastCancer2, the paper's independent across-slide test slide): same as above

prediction_scales: as in the authors' Figure3.ipynb: external slides (breast5k, atera) x0.5, BreastCancer2 across-slide export x1.0; measured target = log1p(raw counts)

placement.random: core centres drawn from random cells
placement.diverse: RNA-free: 400 random candidate cores, each described by the mean of its cells' GHIST+ predictions in a 20-PC space (PCA on 50k random cells' predictions); k-means (k = n_cores) on candidates, pick the non-overlapping candidate nearest each centroid

anchors.candidate_acceptance: a core is accepted only if it holds >= 50% of the median cell count of 200 random cores of the same size (avoids empty edge cores); cores never overlap
anchors.max_total_area_note: configs whose total core area exceeds 20% of the slide's occupied tissue (100 um grid) are skipped and recorded
anchors.evaluation_cells: every cell farther than 200 um from all core edges (the withheld rest of the slide)

methods.calibration: per-gene OLS y = a + b*p on core cells, clipped at 0
methods.ridge: multigene ridge residual: clip(p + c + z(p) @ W, 0); inputs = all genes' standardised GHIST+ predictions; alpha chosen by grouped CV over cores
methods.Adapt: PRIMARY. Per gene, use the ridge output if its out-of-fold PCC on core cells beats GHIST+'s PCC on core cells; otherwise use tie-free rescaled GHIST+ (s_g * p, least squares through the origin on core cells). Falls back toward GHIST+ when cores are uninformative
methods.Adapt-DM: Adapt with per-gene spread matched to the core cells' measured SD (ridge-branch genes: expand around the out-of-fold mean; rescale-branch genes: scale-only), clipped at 0

cv.groups: one group per core; a single core is split into 4 angular sectors
cv.selection: out-of-fold median per-gene PCC pooled over core cells

uncertainty.method: split-conformal per gene from out-of-fold absolute residuals on core cells, alpha = 0.1 (target 90% coverage); interval [max(0, q_hat - r), q_hat + r]
uncertainty.baseline: the same conformal procedure applied to raw GHIST+ predictions
uncertainty.reported: coverage on evaluation cells (median over genes) and mean interval width

metrics.gene_groups: Giotto SVG score (authors' giotto_scores, k = 8) computed once per slide on measured RNA of all cells, as in the paper: top-20 SVG, top-50 SVG, top-50 non-SVG (smallest |score|), all genes
per_gene: Spearman (on up to 100,000 random evaluation cells)
metrics.spatial: SSIM with the authors' grid (width 400 bins, Gaussian sigma 1, 7x7 window) on evaluation cells, for the top-50 SVG and top-50 non-SVG genes
metrics.structure: CMD (paper Eq. 17) on all genes and on the top-50 SVGs
metrics.uncertainty_of_gains: spatial block bootstrap (400 um blocks, 500 resamples) of the median-PCC difference vs GHIST+ over all genes and top-20 SVGs; 95% percentile interval
metrics.rmse_note: RMSE is in log1p units as in the authors' released evaluation; the paper's library-size-normalised RMSE (Eq. 15) needs predicted library sizes and is not computed

headline_configs.primary: 4 cores x 1.0 mm2, diverse placement (a typical TMA budget: 4 mm2 total)
headline_configs.paper_matched: 1 core x 3.5 mm2 (the largest single core in the paper's Fig. 2d)

biology_amendment.added: 2026-11-09, after the smoke-test run started but before any v3 metric was read; secondary analyses only, primary metrics unchanged
biology_amendment.cell_type_programmes: per-cell signature score = mean log1p expression of the authors' Figure3.ipynb marker sets (D_MARKERS: T, B, Plasma, Macrophage, Myeloid, Stromal, Epithelial, Malignant) present in the slide panel (>= 2 markers required); PCC between predicted and measured signature scores over evaluation cells, per programme. Mean-expression scoring is used instead of pyUCell for speed
biology_amendment.adapter_interpretation: for the headline config (4 x 1 mm2, diverse, seed 0) save the ridge weights; for each corrected gene, report its top input genes by |weight| (inputs standardised) and the share of |weight| that comes from genes in the same marker programme vs other programmes

decision_rule: A metric counts as improved for a slide only if the headline-config mean over the 3 repeats beats GHIST+ and, for median PCC, the block-bootstrap 95% interval of the difference excludes 0 in every repeat. Results are reported for every config, method and slide regardless of outcome.
